visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and bangs stands on a paved outdoor walkway on a bright sunny day. She is wearing a white halter-style cutout top, a thin cream cardigan, and black shorts with lace detailing. She appears distressed by the heat, fanning herself with both hands while squinting and puffing out her cheeks. (2) A person's arm enters the frame from the right side, offering a light blue ice pack decorated with geometric patterns and a green screw-top lid. The woman reaches out and accepts the ice pack with both hands, her expression shifting to surprise. (3) She presses the cold ice pack against her cheeks and neck, closing her eyes and leaning into the sensation, conveying a sense of relief and comfort. The background shows a paved plaza with parked cars and trees in the distance under bright natural light. (4) The woman places the ice pack on top of her head, holding it in place while looking directly into the lens. She smiles broadly and winks at the camera. Animated pink blush circles appear on her cheeks as a post-production visual effect.

The use of popular upbeat music and digital blush effects enhances the aesthetic appeal and 'kawaii' vibe of the content.
